mods.name: ColorApocalypse
mods.description: ColorApocalypse is a multiplayer Minecraft mod that turns your survival experience into a chaotic and unpredictable challenge. The concept is simple: the world gradually loses its colors, and each color that disappears causes the instant destruction of all associated blocks in your world.

releases.notes:
**ColorApocalypse** now ships on **Forge**, **Fabric/Quilt**, and **NeoForge** from one shared codebase, with identical features and behavior across all of them same roulette mechanic, same destruction logic, same multiplayer sync.
  
- **Forge: 65.1.2**: reworked internally to support this release. The config system was rewritten from **ForgeConfigSpec** to a hand-rolled JSON config _(**config/colorapocalypse.json**)_, and networking, tick handling, and command registration were decoupled from Forge-specific self-registration so the same code could be shared across loaders. No gameplay or settings changes, this is an internal restructuring, not a new feature.
- **Fabric/Quilt**: **Loader 0.19.4** / **Fabric API 0.158.0+26.2** : brand new platform support.
- **NeoForge: 26.2.0.67** : brand new platform support.

All target Minecraft **26.2**. 
Pick whichever loader you already use the mod behaves the same everywhere.

releases.notes:
## ColorApocalypse v1.0.0 - Initial Release
  
  The world is losing its colors, and it's not giving them back. A wheel spins across your XP bar at random intervals, whatever color it lands on gets wiped from existence: blocks, mobs, and item drops alike.

  ### Features
  
  - **Color wheel mechanic** : a synced multiplayer countdown → spin → reveal sequence, driven by the XP bar, with matching sounds and a full-screen color reveal.
  - **Block destruction** : every block tied to the eliminated color (wool, concrete, terracotta, stained glass, naturally colored blocks like grass/leaves) is destroyed around every player, within a configurable radius.        
  - **Mob death** : mobs of the eliminated color (sheep, wolves, llamas, tropical fish, painted shulkers, and dozens more) die instantly.
  - **Item destruction** :  dropped items of that color are destroyed on the spot; optionally (off by default) the same applies to items sitting in players' inventories and equipment.
  - **Automatic & manual triggers** : the wheel spins on its own based on world difficulty, or an operator can force a draw anytime with `/colorapocalypse start`.
  - **Self-sustaining cycle** : once every color has been eliminated, the pool refills automatically and the apocalypse starts over, no manual reset required.
  - **Fully configurable** ; destruction radius, per-difficulty timers, and every destruction category can be toggled via `/colorapocalypse settings`.
  - **Localized in 35 languages** : every player sees titles, subtitles, and command feedback in their own client language.

  ### Commands (OP only)
  `/colorapocalypse start | status | reset | pause | settings <parameter> <value>`

  ### Requirements
  Minecraft 26.2, Forge 65.1.2

  Full details in the [README](https://github.com/Maxime66410/ColorApocalypse#readme).
